title: Conspiracy m2 (x12b picture, 59.100 s): music under speech at m1's gap level, word-speed sidechain, folder close 2
notes: Audio-only remix of m1 on the x12b picture (picture stream-copied). Liam on the m1 film (2026-10-17): the music too quiet; m1's un-ducked level is about right; keep a little ducking, tight to the words, not only in long pauses; the lifts in the quiet parts too dramatic; stamps a little quieter; replace the folder-close sound.

Music: placement, speed (1.015877) and the end fade are m1's. High-pass 180 -> 100 Hz. The cue is normalised to -18 LUFS integrated, then sits at m1's gap level (-14 dB re the raw cue at 180 Hz, converted to the same loudness on the normalised cue) while Liam speaks and opens by depth_db between words (sidechain on the dialogue stem: 30 ms look-ahead attack, 300 ms release). m1's breakpoint automation is gone: no -20 under speech, no CENSORED? (-10) or bar 22 (-12) swells, no -24 dip before the close.

Effects: the stamps 2 dB quieter than m1. The folder close (m1: whoosh-2-paper-slide ending on the shut + stamp-thump-3 on the shut) is replaced by folder-close-2-doc-folder (Freesound 511699 'document folder open-close #2.wav' by Timbre, CC0 1.0, https://freesound.org/people/Timbre/sounds/511699/; HQ preview trimmed to the first event, -20 LUFS like the other effect files), at m1's folder level (-6 dB); its main impact (the loudest transient, about 0.21 s in; a small precursor about 0.14 s before it is not the hit) on the shut, f1757 (58.567).
Loudness: -16 LUFS integrated, true peak <= -1.3 dBTP before AAC (one delay-compensated limiter, ceiling lowered until the true peak holds).
